privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Rusty collects, uses, and discloses your information when you use our mobile application Rusty.
privacy.permissions_desc: To provide the core functionality of reporting abandoned vehicles, the App requires access to certain features of your device:
privacy.permissions_camera: <0>Camera:</0> We use the camera permission to allow you to take photographs of abandoned vehicles directly within the App. These images are uploaded to our servers as part of your report.
privacy.permissions_location: <0>Location:</0> We use your device's location services (GPS) to automatically tag the precise location of the reported vehicle. This helps us identify where the vehicle is located.
privacy.permissions_notifications: <0>Notifications:</0> We may use notifications to update you on the status of your reports.
privacy.personal_desc: When you create an account, we collect the following personal information:
privacy.usage_desc: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
privacy.usage_service: <0>To provide the Service:</0> To allow you to create, submit, and track reports of abandoned vehicles.
privacy.usage_improve: <0>To improve the App:</0> We analyze usage data to improve the functionality and user experience.
privacy.usage_auth: <0>Authentication:</0> To verify your identity and secure your account.
privacy.thirdparty_desc: We use third-party services that may collect information used to identify you:
privacy.thirdparty_firebase: <0>Google Firebase:</0> We use Firebase for authentication, database storage, and analytics.
privacy.thirdparty_maps: <0>Google Maps:</0> We use Google Maps to display vehicle locations.
privacy.retention_desc: We retain your reports and associated data (photos, location) as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose of the report or as required by law.
privacy.contact_desc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
